issue_context.title: GDScript "Go to definition" doesn't work in certain cases within type hints
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

Godot 4.0 beta 4

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

Script editor allows you to "Go to definition" by simply using Ctrl + Left Click while hovering code. This works seamlessly throughout the editor except for a few cases, one of those cases is when wanting to do so for type hints of on a enum or inner class of a custom class.

As seen below, we're able to prompt a underline of a enum and inner class, and use "Go to definition", when hovering over it's usage within the value declaration:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17155529/201032960-e90115ee-176c-4f18-9cc4-3bb3d63e2e40.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17155529/201033222-958eb178-5d9e-46b8-a55c-1b39e5b304a8.png)

However, when wanting to "Go to definition" for the same enum or inner class defined in the type hint it won't even prompt a underline much less work:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17155529/201033463-c770e116-493d-40e2-add6-13b7b6099f6a.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17155529/201033071-bbcb05d4-8126-4759-b2d9-109dfdb45058.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17155529/201033520-8faa86c6-144a-4f71-99e9-da215653add1.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17155529/201033297-59ec3d80-fea8-4e8d-9a62-a9db214fb547.png)

Clip demonstrating "Go to definition" working fine in various cases, but not working within the scope of type hint:


https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17155529/201033836-9e2079b0-166b-43dc-a6c8-1fa6823aba0b.mp4




### Steps to reproduce

1. Open example project
2. Open custom_class_b.gd
3. Hover over ".CustomEnum" at the end of line 5
4. Press `Ctrl + Left Click`
5. No highlight and no going to definition will occur
6. Hover over ".CustomEnum" in the type hint of line 7
7. Press `Ctrl + Left Click`
8. No highlight and no going to definition will occur
9. Hover over ".CustomEnum" in the value declaration of line 7
10. Press `Ctrl + Left Click`
11. Highlighting and going to definition will occur
12. Hover over ".CustomInnerClass" at the end of line 10
13. Press `Ctrl + Left Click`
14. No highlight and no going to definition will occur
15. Hover over ".CustomInnerClass" in the type hint of line 12
16. Press `Ctrl + Left Click`
17. No highlight and no going to definition will occur
18. Hover over ".CustomInnerClass" in the value declaration of line 12
19. Press `Ctrl + Left Click`
20. Highlighting and going to definition will occur

### Minimal reproduction project

[example.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/9978631/example.zip)

review_comments: Is `type` guaranteed to be not null in here? If not, it needs to be ensured right after.
I added a check to be safe
